# React Gotchas

> Known React patterns that cause infinite loops, memory leaks, or silent state bugs. Load all HIGH entries before writing React components.

## Entries

- [useEffect infinite loop when state setter depends on its own state](useeffect-infinite-loop.md): Calling setState inside useEffect with that state in the dependency array creates an infinite re-render loop. HIGH.
- [setTimeout in useEffect without cleanup fires after unmount](settimeout-cleanup.md): setTimeout scheduled in useEffect fires even after unmount, updating stale state. Always return a cleanup function. MEDIUM.
- [base-ui Select shows the raw value in its collapsed trigger without an items prop](base-ui-select-items-prop-collapsed-trigger.md): Children-only SelectItem labels don't resolve before mount or for values missing from the mounted list, so the trigger silently shows raw enums/ids; always pass items={[{value,label}]} and resolve labels for stale values. MEDIUM.
- [Unmount flush resurrects localStorage state cleared by another component](unmount-flush-resurrects-cleared-state.md): An autosave hook's flush-on-unmount re-saves a draft another component just cleared (discard then navigate unmounts AFTER the clear); pair the external clear with an event that makes the flush a no-op. MEDIUM.
- [react-hooks/set-state-in-effect is an ERROR, breaking post-fetch state reconciliation](set-state-in-effect-is-an-error.md): Recent eslint-plugin-react-hooks presets ship the rule at error severity, and it matches lexically: it flags any component-scope function containing setState when called from an effect (even fully-async loaders that cannot cascade) while accepting an async IIFE that genuinely does. Move reconciliation into the fetch callback; use render-phase adjustment for the reset-on-dep-change family. The identity-stable updater trick does NOT silence it. MEDIUM.
- [Clearing react-hooks/immutability by hoisting a fetcher unmasks set-state-in-effect](immutability-hoist-unmasks-set-state-in-effect.md): Hoisting a fetcher above the effect to fix "Cannot access variable before it is declared" is what finally lets set-state-in-effect resolve the binding, so it starts erroring on a line you never touched; the originally-reported errors go away while the file still fails lint. It reports only once per effect (first offending call), and neither moving setState out of `finally` nor deleting a synchronous pre-await setState silences it. MEDIUM.
- [A hook returning a ref inside its result object makes every property read of that object a ref access](hook-returning-ref-in-object-flags-every-read.md): The compiler marks the whole returned object as a ref, so `style={resize.styleVars}` and every other plain read in the CALLER's JSX errors with "Cannot access refs during render" while the message never names the offending property; often masked behind a more obvious violation, so it materialises only after you fix that one. Have the caller own the ref and pass it in. MEDIUM.
- [`data ?? []` during a query's loading gap hard-freezes the tab via an uncommitted render loop](query-loading-gap-empty-array-identity-render-loop.md): When a query key changes, `data` is undefined for a beat and `?? []` mints a new array each render; once that identity reaches `useReactTable`'s data/columns the grid re-renders forever without committing a frame. React throws nothing (the guards cover nested updates, not render-phase loops), nothing is logged, no DOM work happens, and screenshots keep serving the last painted frame, so it reads as a hung request rather than a spun main thread. Hoist empty fallbacks to module constants and memoize anything feeding a query key or the grid. HIGH.
- [TanStack Table v9 moves column APIs onto a prototype, so passing `column.setFilterValue` by reference detaches it](tanstack-v9-column-api-detached-from-prototype.md): v8 gave each column its own closures, v9 assigns column/row/header/cell APIs onto a shared prototype that reads its receiver from `this`, so a detached reference is called with `this` undefined and dies on `column.table` inside the feature; the signature is unchanged so tsc and lint both pass and the break is runtime-only, taking out every filter in the app while the popover still opens and lists its options. Table APIs are the exception (closures that capture the table, safe to detach), which makes "it works for table.x" the wrong inference. A hand-rolled column stub has own properties and no prototype, so it passes with the bug in place -- the regression test must take the column off a real useTable instance. HIGH.
- [Resolve dialog success before emitting its close callback](success-before-dialog-close.md): A parent may interpret close as cancellation and consume every waiter before the success callback can retry the original request. HIGH.
- [Mixing draft filters with immediate selectors silently discards pending edits](mixed-draft-and-applied-filters-discard-edits.md): Immediate selector navigation merges old applied filters and can remount an editor, silently dropping pending date/search changes; use one draft and explicit Apply, with safe option validation. HIGH.

- [Escape can dismiss a portal and also trigger page navigation](escape-portal-dismissal-page-navigation.md): A portal may unmount before a window shortcut queries for overlays; respect defaultPrevented and the original menu/dialog target before navigating. HIGH.
- [react-hooks/purity rejects Date.now() and new Date() during render](react-hooks-purity-date-in-render.md): A dialog that validates "a minute from now" or seeds a default time in render fails lint; mount the form per opening and capture the clock in a lazy useState initializer. MEDIUM.
- [React Flow: fitView from an effect on useNodesInitialized never fires with explicit node sizes](react-flow-fitview-timing-with-explicit-sizes.md): With width/height set on nodes, the initial fit belongs in the `fitView` prop (with `fitViewOptions`); later refits go in an effect calling `fitView()` in a requestAnimationFrame. MEDIUM.
- [drei <Html fullscreen> is anchored to its group's projected position, not the canvas corner](drei-html-fullscreen-anchored-to-its-group.md): A screen-space label overlay built with drei `<Html fullscreen>` at the scene root is offset by the world origin's screen position, so every label drifts off its object by that amount; use a plain DOM overlay sibling of <Canvas> and place labels from a useFrame driver. HIGH.
- [Keep drei Html portal targets stable during Canvas teardown](drei-html-stable-portal-during-teardown.md): An implicit Html target can change while Canvas disconnects, recreating its React DOM root during cleanup and raising removeChild errors; use a stable explicit container and test mounted-scene transitions. HIGH.
- [Automatic query retries can reopen canceled identity dialogs](query-retries-reopen-canceled-identity-dialogs.md): Transport-level cancellation returns a refusal that an outer query or mutation retry repeats, reopening verification; preserve structured errors and exclude authorization refusals from automatic retries. HIGH.

- [Forward progress values to the accessible primitive](forward-progress-value-to-accessible-primitive.md): A wrapper can render a determinate bar while dropping its accessible value; forward value and test zero, partial, complete and omitted states. HIGH.
- [ProseMirror handleDrop does not stop a drop bubbling to a React onDrop on its wrapper](prosemirror-handledrop-bubbles-to-wrapper-ondrop.md): Returning true from Tiptap/ProseMirror handleDrop only calls preventDefault, so a wrapping drop zone also runs and every dropped file is attached twice with no error; give file drops one owner and have the editor only claim them. In jsdom, stub view.posAtCoords or the drop never reaches handleDrop. HIGH.
- [A poll that starts during a mutation overwrites the optimistic update](poll-during-mutation-overwrites-optimistic-update.md): cancelQueries cancels only fetches already running, so a refetchInterval poll that starts while the write is in flight returns the old state and the item jumps back. Pause the interval while useIsMutating is above zero. HIGH.
- [A form that reads its default once submits the wrong scope when the default is still loading](form-default-read-once-submits-wrong-scope.md): useState(initial) and defaultValue read once, so a form mounted while its scoped default is still loading keeps the wide fallback: an approve form opened from a row menu took "all organizations" before the device's organization had loaded. Do not mount the form until the default has settled, and make empty mean "nothing chosen". HIGH.
- [A single-key shortcut also fires as the last key of a key sequence](single-key-shortcut-fires-inside-key-sequence.md): Independent window keydown listeners for `g a` (a sequence) and `a` (a hotkey) both run on the second key, so navigating also performs the single-key action; make single keys stand aside for a short window after a leader key. HIGH.
- [A selection kept after a bulk action reaches rows that are no longer on screen](kept-selection-must-be-pruned-to-loaded-rows.md): Keeping selectedIds after a bulk action, or across a list switch on a page that does not remount, lets the next action hit rows that left the list; prune the selection to the loaded ids and key its reset on the list identity as well as the filters. HIGH.
- [A keyboard action resolved by focused index acts on a different row after the list changes](focused-row-by-index-acts-on-a-different-row.md): visibleRows[focusIdx] is resolved at key press, so a poll that prepends a row or a re-sort moves another record under the same index and the shortcut edits it; track the focused id, and ignore the key when that row is not in the viewport. HIGH.
- [An async insert that outlives a mode switch lands in the wrong document](async-insert-outlives-editor-mode-switch.md): A fetch started in one editor mode (internal note) resolves after the user switched to another (public reply) and inserts its result there, at a position from the old document; capture the mode and a document counter at the start and drop a stale result. HIGH.
- [Clearing the editor after a send clears whatever is in it now, not what was sent](clear-after-send-clears-the-current-document.md): editor.commands.clearContent() in a send success handler wipes the text of the mode the user switched to while the request was in flight, and the draft autosave then deletes that mode's stored draft; block mode switches during a send and clear only if the mode is unchanged. HIGH.
- [Moving a component into a Radix Dialog at a breakpoint remounts it and loses its state](radix-dialog-portal-remounts-moved-content.md): Dialog content renders through a portal, so a panel shown inline at wide widths and inside a Dialog below them is a different mount each time the breakpoint is crossed, discarding open sections, half-typed fields and one-time values. MEDIUM.
- [A disabled fieldset does not stop a forwarded pointer event from opening a Radix trigger](disabled-fieldset-does-not-stop-simulated-pointer-events.md): Wrapping a section in <fieldset disabled> makes native controls inert, but a card that forwards its click to an inner trigger with dispatched pointer events still opens the menu; pass disabled to each control. MEDIUM.
- [A refetch under a new query key shows the skeleton and throws away the scroll position](refetch-without-placeholder-data-loses-scroll-position.md): Bumping a refresh key in the query key makes data undefined for a beat, the skeleton replaces the list, the browser clamps scrollTop, and nothing scrolls back; use placeholderData for the same record so the old page stays on screen. MEDIUM.
- [A remembered tab backed by an endpoint the viewer cannot call is a permanent error state](remembered-tab-backed-by-forbidden-endpoint.md): A tab whose data endpoint is admin-only shows "couldn't load, try again" to everyone else, retry never works, and a remembered tab choice keeps them landing on it; offer the tab by role and fall back when the stored tab is unavailable. MEDIUM.
- [TanStack Query: removeQueries does not redraw a page that is already showing the data, so sign-out can leave the previous person's rows on screen](removequeries-does-not-redraw-a-page-already-showing-the-data.md): Clearing the cache on sign-out does not re-render mounted components, so the next person can see the previous person's rows until a refetch; remount the protected subtree by keying it on the signed-in identity and drop late responses from the old session. HIGH.
- [React retries a failing render before an error boundary sees it](react-retries-a-failing-render-before-the-error-boundary.md): A test that counts renders, calls made during render, or logged errors sees more than one; assert the fallback, not an exact count. MEDIUM.
